assets.ti: JAL 1628: written statement by Capt. Terauchi (English translation by Sakoyo Mimoto)
assets.de: Captain Kenju Terauchi's written statement on the 17 November 1986 sighting, in an English translation by Sakoyo Mimoto. From the FAA series "Information Releases Relating to Unidentified Flying Object" (National Archives, NAID 40586988).

assets.ti: JAL 1628: transcript of FAA interview with Capt. Terauchi by Dick Gordon (2 Jan 1987)
assets.de: Transcript of the FAA's 2 January 1987 interview of Captain Kenju Terauchi by Dick Gordon about the 17 November 1986 sighting over Alaska. From the FAA series "Information Releases Relating to Unidentified Flying Object" (National Archives, NAID 40587003).

The FAA's chronology of the 17 November 1986 JAL flight 1628 sighting over Alaska and the agency's follow-up. From the FAA series "Information Releases Relating to Unidentified Flying Object" (National Archives, NAID 40587180).

assets.ti: JAL 1628: FAA explanation of the split beacon target
assets.de: The FAA's explanation of the split beacon target seen on radar during the 17 November 1986 JAL flight 1628 sighting. From the FAA series "Information Releases Relating to Unidentified Flying Object" (National Archives, NAID 40587480).

assets.ti: JAL 1628: FAA public affairs news releases
assets.de: News releases issued by FAA public affairs about the 17 November 1986 JAL flight 1628 sighting and the FAA's review. From the FAA series "Information Releases Relating to Unidentified Flying Object" (National Archives, NAID 40587486).

assets.ti: JAL 1628: record of communication with the FAA administrator and the U.S. Air Force
assets.de: FAA records of communication with the FAA administrator and with the U.S. Air Force about the 17 November 1986 JAL flight 1628 sighting. From the FAA series "Information Releases Relating to Unidentified Flying Object" (National Archives, NAID 40587497).

assets.ti: Project Blue Book case file: Socorro, New Mexico, April 1964
assets.de: The Air Force's Project Blue Book case file on police officer Lonnie Zamora's report of a landed object at Socorro on 24 April 1964; the record card carries the case as UNIDENTIFIED. 168 pages from the National Archives' sanitized Blue Book case files (RG 341, NAID 302532129; images provided by Fold3).
